title: sshdump: add option to select dumpcap as remote capture command
description:
Extend sshdump to allow explicit selection of the desired capture program, either tcpdump (default), dumpcap, or other. ![image](/uploads/39cd8ea54230608453fe3016310d2a7c/image.png) As was present, the tcpdump command line is compiled from the parameters given in this dialog. The same now hold true when selecting dumpcap.
Moreover this allows for capture of multiple interfaces, since the dumpcap command line supports that.

commits_data.message:
sshdump: add option to select dumpcap as remote capture command

Add the option to the dialog and generate dumpcap command line if
requested. The default remains tcpdump, as it was before.
Amend the documentation the reflect the current output of the extcap.
